content:
The **peregrine falcon** is the fastest animal in the world. It can reach speeds of **over 240 mph (390 km/h)** when diving (called a "stoop") to catch prey.

For other categories:

- **Fastest land animal:** Cheetah — up to ~70 mph (112 km/h) in short bursts
- **Fastest fish:** Black marlin or sailfish — estimated around 60–80 mph (96–130 km/h)
- **Fastest animal in level flight:** Often credited to the white-throated needletail swift — about 105 mph (169 km/h)

Let me know if you'd like more details about any of these!
